description: This file implements D3D9-specific wrapper classes for render targets, including TextureRenderTarget9 and SurfaceRenderTarget9, managing Direct3D surfaces and textures for rendering.

classes.name: TextureRenderTarget9
classes.description: A wrapper for a D3D9 texture and surface used as a render target.

classes.name: SurfaceRenderTarget9
classes.description: A wrapper for a D3D9 surface, either for a swap chain or depth/stencil buffer.

methods.name: TextureRenderTarget9
methods.description: Constructor initializing texture, surface, and format info.

methods.name: ~TextureRenderTarget9
methods.description: Destructor releasing resources.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the render target.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the render target.

methods.name: getDepth
methods.description: Returns the depth of the render target.

methods.name: getInternalFormat
methods.description: Returns the internal format of the render target.

methods.name: getSamples
methods.description: Returns the number of samples for multisampling.

methods.name: getTexture
methods.description: Returns the associated texture object.

methods.name: getTextureLevel
methods.description: Returns the texture level.

methods.name: getSurface
methods.description: Returns the D3D surface, adding a reference.

methods.name: getD3DFormat
methods.description: Returns the D3D format of the surface.

methods.name: SurfaceRenderTarget9
methods.description: Constructor initializing with swap chain and depth flag.

methods.name: ~SurfaceRenderTarget9
methods.description: Destructor.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns width from swap chain.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns height from swap chain.

methods.name: getDepth
methods.description: Returns fixed depth of 1.

methods.name: getInternalFormat
methods.description: Returns internal format based on depth flag.

methods.name: getSamples
methods.description: Returns 0, as multisampling is not supported.

methods.name: getSurface
methods.description: Returns the surface from swap chain.

methods.name: getTexture
methods.description: Returns offscreen texture if not depth.

methods.name: getTextureLevel
methods.description: Returns 0.

methods.name: getD3DFormat
methods.description: Returns D3D format info for internal format.
